newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh plans to import 57,000 tonnes of sugar.

DHAKA, June 4 (Reuter) - Bangladesh plans to import 57,000 tonnes of white sugar by October, the chief of state-owned Bangladesh Sugar and Food Industries Corporation said on Wednesday. Bangladesh has already imported 93,000 tonnes of sugar out of an import target of 150,000 tonnes for fiscal 1996/97 ending on June 30, A.K. Munshi, chairman of the corporation told Reuters in an interview. Corporation officials said a bidding for 25,000 tonnes of sugar was due on Sunday.
